gist.summary: Added InkBloom to the image app catalog and README. InkBloom turns photos or text prompts into printable coloring pages; its text-to-coloring generation uses Pollinations.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art workspace, Polli wears a tiny painter’s beret and watches a photo and a text prompt become printable flower coloring pages, with lime green (#ecf874) pots and soft pastel gradients around the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic — cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
